en: Eclipse Gundam, additional weapons
"Manufacturer Striker" on the move!
New equipment that can be installed on "MG 1/100 Eclipse Gundam" (sold separately 20218 over-the-counter sales product),
Introducing the Maneuver Striker Pack. In addition to flexible movement with each arm, it can also be transformed into a fighter aircraft form.
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the MS form, this product and "MG 1/100 Eclipse Gundam" (sold separately, 20218 over-the-counter product) are required.
●A new Striker Pack that works with the MG Eclipse Gundam is now available.
"Mobile Suit GundamSEED ECLIPSE" Can be attached to the main character Eclipse Gundam as a striker pack.
Precisely molded four booster units.
● Can also be installed in MA form
The Maneuver Striker Pack can be attached even when Eclipse Gundam is in MA form.
● Can be transformed into fighter aircraft form
This product alone can be transformed into a fighter aircraft form.
● Dynamic actions that match Eclipse Gundam are possible.
The four booster units can be flexibly moved by the arms.
● Can be installed on Strike Gundam Ver.RM.
Can be attached as a striker pack to the separately sold "MG 1/100 Ale Strike Gundamver.RM (in-store release product)".
<Set contents> Maneuver Striker pack complete set / Optional weapons for Maneuver Striker / Display base
